reviewer: Codex direct reading against source results, supplied packets and experiment definitions
scope: Post-run qualitative audit, not a preregistered or independent semantic benchmark. Raw model drafts are unchanged. Identifier-based selection was frozen before this review.

findings: Brier score alone does not establish comparable calibration quality or low absolute error without an appropriate reference.
Calls positive error contrast a predictive edge. Here contrast is region Brier loss minus pooled-rest Brier loss; positive contrast identifies higher error.
Calls Brier measurements predictive calibration and refers to intervals elsewhere in a point-estimate packet.
Values are correctly rounded and qualifications retained. Improve the ambiguous reflection/confirmation sample phrasing: one proposal and one shared confirmation sample.
Defines contrast as control-vs-treatment error. It is region-minus-pooled-rest error, not a treatment contrast.
Infers predictive calibration from Brier scores.
Calls lower contrast better. This search maximizes weakness contrast; lower regional loss also does not establish model repair across different subsets.
Infers comparable predictive calibration from Brier values.
Omits fixed-predictor and structural-change qualifications. Continuation share 0.0999 is truncated rather than correctly rounded to four decimals.
Converts absence of variance estimates in the supplied packet into absence in the underlying data. The experiment has saved standard errors and simultaneous intervals.
Exact supplied numbers and comparison direction preserved. Simplify wording and distinguish reporting discovery packets from numerical confirmation observations.
Claims no meaningful divergence from close point estimates without a materiality or equivalence criterion. The packet supplies no such criterion.

interpretation: Seven of nine drafts need substantive revision. Two had no substantive error identified in this review; this is not a certification. Six of nine passed identifier coverage, including the reserved draft that made an unsupported materiality statement.
design_limitation: The reference projection supplies values and units but does not include full metric definitions. A future separately versioned experiment should test definition-rich packets and semantic acceptance gates. Do not retrofit those changes into these results.
